title: 口令存储的正确做法
summary: 口令存储只需要三件事：用慢哈希、加盐、以及可调成本。做错其中任何一件，一次拖库就等于明文泄露。
summary_en: Password storage needs three things: a slow hash, a salt, and a tunable cost. Miss any one and a database dump is equivalent to plaintext.

sections.h: 为什么不能只做一次哈希
sections.h_en: Why one hash is not enough
sections.p: 普通哈希函数设计目标是快，攻击者可以用显卡每秒尝试数十亿次。加盐只解决彩虹表与相同口令产生相同哈希的问题，不解决速度问题。真正需要的是"故意慢"的算法，并且成本可随硬件提升而上调——这就是口令哈希函数存在的意义。
sections.p_en: General-purpose hashes are designed to be fast; attackers try billions per second on GPUs. Salting solves rainbow tables and identical hashes for identical passwords but not speed. What you need is deliberately slow, with a cost that rises as hardware improves — which is what password hashing functions exist for.

sections.p: Argon2id 是当前首选，内存硬度高，抗显卡与专用硬件；bcrypt 成熟稳定，注意输入长度上限与不要截断；scrypt 在内存受限环境里可用。PBKDF2 是最后的合规兜底选项，迭代次数要足够高。共同点是都必须自带盐与成本参数，并随算法输出一起存储。
sections.p_en: Argon2id is the current first choice for memory hardness against GPUs and ASICs; bcrypt is mature (mind the input length limit, do not truncate); scrypt works where memory is constrained. PBKDF2 is the last-resort compliance option with high iteration counts. All must carry their own salt and cost parameters stored alongside the output.

code.title: 用 argon2 而不是 MD5/SHA
code.note: 输出字符串自带算法与参数，未来提升成本时可平滑迁移，无需强制所有人重设口令
code.note_en: The output carries algorithm and parameters, so raising cost later migrates smoothly without forcing resets

sections.p: 不要照抄网上的固定数字。正确方法是在目标部署机器上实测：调参数直到单次校验耗时达到可接受范围（常见目标是 100–500 毫秒），再留出余量。太高会让登录接口成为拒绝服务的放大器，太低则无法抵御离线爆破。参数要写进配置并记录调整时间，否则一年后没人知道为什么是这个值。
sections.p_en: Do not copy numbers from the internet. Measure on the target deployment machine: tune until a single verification takes an acceptable time (100 to 500 ms is common), then leave headroom. Too high turns login into a denial-of-service amplifier; too low fails against offline cracking. Record the parameters and when they changed.

sections.p: 上线后提升成本参数时，正确做法是在校验成功后检查存储的参数是否低于当前标准，若低于则用新参数重新哈希并更新——用户无感完成迁移。另外两个常见漏洞要一并处理：登录失败信息不要区分"用户不存在"和"口令错误"；以及重置口令令牌必须一次性且短时效。
sections.p_en: When raising cost parameters, the correct approach is to verify, then check whether the stored parameters are below the current standard and rehash with new ones if so — a silent migration. Also handle two common leaks: never distinguish user-not-found from wrong-password in login errors, and make reset tokens single-use with a short expiry.

refs.name: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

quiz.q: 加盐能解决什么问题，不能解决什么问题？
options: 能防彩虹表与相同口令同哈希，不能解决哈希函数本身太快
quiz.explain: 盐改变输入，不改变算法速度，因此还需要慢哈希。
quiz.q_en: What does salting solve and not solve?
options_en: It stops rainbow tables and identical hashes, but not the hash being too fast
quiz.explain_en: A salt changes the input, not the algorithm speed, so a slow hash is still required.

quiz.q: 口令哈希的成本参数应该如何确定？
options: 在目标机器上实测校验耗时，取可接受范围内的值并留余量
quiz.explain: 过高会让登录接口变成拒绝服务放大器，过低挡不住离线爆破。
quiz.q_en: How should password hashing cost be chosen?
options_en: Measure verification time on the target machine and take an acceptable value with headroom
quiz.explain_en: Too high turns login into a DoS amplifier; too low fails against offline cracking.

quiz.q: 登录失败时为什么不应区分"用户不存在"与"口令错误"？
options: 否则攻击者可据此枚举有效用户名
quiz.explain: 不同错误信息是用户名枚举的直接通道。
quiz.q_en: Why should login not distinguish user-not-found from wrong-password?
options_en: Otherwise attackers can enumerate valid usernames
quiz.explain_en: Distinct error messages are a direct username enumeration channel.

title: 令牌设计与会话失效
summary: 令牌的核心难题不是怎么签发，而是怎么让它该死的时候真的死。无状态令牌省了查库，代价是撤销变得困难。
summary_en: The hard problem with tokens is not issuing them but making them die when they should. Stateless tokens save a lookup and make revocation hard.

sections.h: 无状态与可撤销的取舍
sections.p: 自包含令牌把身份与权限编码进去，服务端不查库即可验证，扩展性好。但它天生不可撤销：签发出去就有效到过期。缓解手段是缩短有效期并配合刷新令牌，让"最长存活时间"降到一个可接受的值。如果业务要求秒级踢人下线，就必须引入服务端状态（黑名单或版本号）。
sections.p_en: Self-contained tokens encode identity and permissions so the server validates without a lookup, which scales well. They are inherently non-revocable: once issued, valid until expiry. Mitigate with short lifetimes plus refresh tokens so the maximum lifetime is acceptable. If the business needs instant logout, server-side state (denylist or version counter) is required.

sections.p: 一、短有效期 + 刷新令牌：最通用，代价是刷新逻辑本身要防重放。二、令牌版本号：用户记录上存一个数字，令牌里带上它，改口令或点"退出所有设备"时递增，校验时比对。三、黑名单：精确但需要存储与清理。三者复杂度递增，按实际需求选，不要一上来就上黑名单。
sections.p_en: Short lifetime plus refresh tokens, the most common, at the cost of protecting the refresh endpoint from replay. A token version number on the user record, incremented on password change or logout-everywhere and compared at validation. A denylist, precise but requiring storage and cleanup. Complexity rises in that order; pick to need.

code.title: 版本号实现全设备失效
code.bad:
// Expiry only: old tokens stay valid after a password change
const payload = { sub: user.id };
code.note: 一次数据库写入就让该用户所有旧令牌失效，不需要维护黑名单集合
code.note_en: One write invalidates every old token for that user without maintaining a denylist

sections.h_en: Storage location decides the attack surface
sections.p: 浏览器场景下，放在可被脚本读取的存储里等于把令牌交给任何一次 XSS。放在仅服务端可读的 Cookie 里可以阻挡脚本读取，但要防 CSRF。桌面与本地应用则相反：没有同源策略的保护，令牌应放在系统凭据库里而不是配置文件。位置选择本质上是在"防 XSS"与"防 CSRF"之间取舍，没有两全的方案。
sections.p_en: In browsers, storage readable by scripts hands the token to any XSS. A server-only cookie blocks script reads but invites CSRF. Desktop and local apps are the opposite: with no same-origin protection, tokens belong in the OS credential store rather than a config file. The choice trades XSS resistance against CSRF resistance; there is no option that wins both.

sections.p: 五个问题：改口令后旧令牌还能用吗？点退出后令牌立即失效吗？刷新令牌是否一次性、是否绑定设备或来源？令牌里是否塞了不该有的敏感信息（它只是编码不是加密）？过期时间是否合理而不是"永不过期"？这五个问题答不出"能"的，都对应一个实际存在的漏洞。
sections.p_en: Five questions: does an old token still work after a password change? Does logout invalidate immediately? Is the refresh token single-use and bound to a device or origin? Does the token carry sensitive data it should not (it is encoding, not encryption)? Is expiry sane rather than never? Any no maps to a real vulnerability.

quiz.q: 自包含令牌最本质的缺陷是什么？
options: 签发后到过期前不可撤销，除非引入服务端状态
quiz.explain: 服务端不查库意味着它无法知道某个令牌已被要求作废。
quiz.q_en: What is the essential weakness of self-contained tokens?
options_en: They cannot be revoked between issue and expiry without server-side state
quiz.explain_en: No lookup means the server cannot know a token was invalidated.

quiz.q: 用令牌版本号实现全设备失效的优点是什么？
options: 一次写入即让该用户全部旧令牌失效，无需维护黑名单集合
quiz.explain: 版本号是单点比较，黑名单需要持续写入与清理。
quiz.q_en: What is the advantage of a token version number for logout-everywhere?
options_en: One write invalidates all old tokens without maintaining a denylist
quiz.explain_en: A version comparison is a single check; a denylist needs continuous writes and cleanup.

quiz.q: 把令牌存在浏览器可被脚本读取的位置，主要风险是什么？
options: 任何一次 XSS 都能直接窃取令牌
quiz.explain: 这正是"防 XSS"与"防 CSRF"取舍的由来，没有两全方案。
quiz.q_en: What is the main risk of storing a token where scripts can read it?
options_en: Any XSS can steal the token directly
quiz.explain_en: This is exactly the XSS-versus-CSRF tradeoff; no option wins both.

title: 多因素认证的绕过面
summary: 开了双因素不等于安全。攻击者不破解第二因素，而是绕过它：找没被保护的入口、骗用户输入验证码、或者劫持已经通过验证的会话。
summary_en: Enabling MFA is not safety. Attackers do not break the second factor; they route around it via unprotected entry points, live phishing of codes, or hijacking an already-verified session.

sections.p: 一、入口不一致：网页登录要第二因素，API 或旧版客户端不要。二、实时钓鱼：攻击者架一个代理页面，用户在自己页面输入验证码，代理立刻转发到真站，验证码在有效期内被用掉。三、会话劫持：绕过登录环节，直接偷取已认证的 Cookie 或令牌。四、恢复流程：账户恢复、客服重置这类旁路往往比主流程弱得多。
sections.p_en: Inconsistent entry points: the web login demands a second factor while the API or an old client does not. Real-time phishing: a proxy page collects the code and forwards it within its validity window. Session hijacking: skip login and steal an authenticated cookie or token. Recovery flows: account recovery and helpdesk reset are often far weaker than the main path.

sections.h: 为什么验证码转发如此有效
sections.h_en: Why code relaying works so well
sections.p: 因为大多数验证码的本质是"证明你此刻持有某个东西"，而不是"证明你就是本人"。代理页面让用户在真实时刻生成真实验证码，攻击者只是把它搬到了另一个会话里使用。任何基于共享秘密的一次性口令都挡不住这种中继，因为秘密本身被正确地产生了，只是被用在了别处。
sections.p_en: Most codes prove you possess something right now, not that you are the person. A proxy lets the user generate a genuine code at the right moment, and the attacker merely relocates it into another session. Any shared-secret one-time code cannot stop relaying, because the secret was generated correctly — it was just used elsewhere.

sections.p: 真正有效的方案把认证绑定到具体来源：基于公钥的认证（如 FIDO 类硬件密钥）在协议层面校验请求来源域名，代理页面拿不到有效签名；或是把令牌绑定到客户端证书或设备指纹。判断标准很简单：这个第二因素能否被用户"读出来告诉别人"？能读出来的，就能被转发。
sections.p_en: Effective options bind authentication to an origin: public-key credentials (FIDO-style hardware keys) validate the requesting domain at the protocol level, so a proxy cannot obtain a valid signature; or bind the token to a client certificate or device identity. The test is simple: can the user read the factor aloud to someone else? If yes, it can be relayed.

sections.p: 第一步先消除入口不一致：把所有认证入口统一到同一套策略，尤其是 API 与自助服务。第二步关闭弱恢复流程，改为更严格的验证并记录审计。第三步才对高权限账户推广抗钓鱼因素。顺序很重要——先把"绕过面"堵住，再提升单个因素强度，否则攻击者永远走最弱的那条路。
sections.p_en: First eliminate inconsistent entry points by unifying all authentication under one policy, especially APIs and self-service. Second, tighten recovery flows and log them. Third, roll out phishing-resistant factors for privileged accounts. Order matters: close bypass surfaces before strengthening individual factors, or attackers always take the weakest path.

quiz.q: 为什么基于共享秘密的一次性验证码挡不住代理式实时钓鱼？
options: 因为验证码证明的是"此刻持有"而非"本人"，可被中继到另一会话使用
quiz.explain: 秘密被正确产生，只是被用在了别处，这类中继无法用强度解决。
quiz.q_en: Why cannot a shared-secret one-time code stop proxy-based live phishing?
options_en: The code proves possession now, not identity, so it can be relayed to another session
quiz.explain_en: The secret is generated correctly; it is simply used elsewhere. Relaying is not a strength problem.

quiz.q: 判断一个第二因素是否抗钓鱼，最简单的检验是什么？
options: 看用户能否把它读出来告诉别人，能读出来就能被转发
quiz.explain: 可被人类读出并转述的因素，天然可以被中继。
quiz.q_en: What is the simplest test of phishing resistance for a factor?
options_en: Whether a user can read it aloud to someone else; readable means relayable
quiz.explain_en: Anything a human can read and repeat can inherently be relayed.

quiz.q: 推进多因素认证时，为什么应先消除入口不一致？
options: 否则攻击者永远走没被保护的入口，单个因素再强也没用
quiz.explain: 绕过面的存在让强度投入失去意义，先堵路再加固。
quiz.q_en: Why eliminate inconsistent entry points before strengthening factors?
options_en: Otherwise attackers use the unprotected entry and stronger factors do not matter
quiz.explain_en: A bypass surface makes strength investment meaningless; close paths first.

title: OAuth 接入的常见错误
summary: OAuth 是授权框架而不是认证协议。把它当登录用会引入一串问题，最常见的是回调地址校验不严与状态参数缺失。
summary_en: OAuth is an authorization framework, not an authentication protocol. Using it as login invites a family of problems, most commonly loose redirect validation and a missing state parameter.

sections.p: 一、回调地址用前缀或子串匹配，攻击者用相似域名接走授权码。二、缺少或未校验状态参数，导致可以把用户引导到攻击者账户完成绑定（登录 CSRF）。三、隐式模式直接在 URL 里返回令牌，容易通过日志与 Referer 泄露。三者都属于"实现细节出错"，而非协议本身有洞。
sections.p_en: Redirect URI matched by prefix or substring, letting a lookalike domain receive the code. A missing or unvalidated state parameter, enabling login CSRF where a victim is bound to an attacker account. Implicit flow returning tokens in the URL, leaking via logs and Referer. All are implementation errors, not protocol holes.

sections.h: 回调地址必须精确匹配
sections.p: 正确做法是在服务端注册完整回调地址，校验时做完整字符串比较，不接受通配、不接受子路径、不接受参数顺序变化。听起来很严格，实际只有少数几个固定回调，成本极低。放松这条规则换来的"方便"，是把授权码交给任何能构造相似域名的人。
sections.p_en: Register the full redirect URI server-side and compare the complete string: no wildcards, no subpaths, no parameter reordering. It sounds strict but there are only a few fixed callbacks, so the cost is trivial. The convenience gained by loosening this rule is handing the code to anyone who can construct a lookalike domain.

code.title: 回调校验必须是白名单精确匹配
code.bad:
// Prefix match: https://app.example.com.evil.com also passes
if (!redirect.startsWith("https://app.example.com")) reject();
code.note: 前缀匹配是经典陷阱：攻击者只需在合法域名后追加自己的域名即可通过
code.title_en: Redirect validation must be an exact allowlist match
code.note_en: Prefix matching is a classic trap: appending your own domain after the legitimate one passes

sections.h: state 参数的作用常被误解
sections.p: state 不是可选项，它防止的是"攻击者把自己的授权码塞给受害者"，从而把受害者账户与攻击者身份绑定。正确实现是：发起授权时生成随机值存进会话，回调时比对，不匹配直接拒绝。凡是没校验这个值的地方，都允许攻击者完成账户串联。
sections.p_en: state is not optional: it prevents an attacker from injecting their own authorization code into a victim session, binding the victim account to the attacker. Implement by generating a random value at initiation, storing it in session, and rejecting on mismatch. Any place lacking this check permits account stitching.

sections.h: 桌面与本地应用的额外注意
sections.h_en: Extra care for desktop and local apps
sections.p: 本地应用没有固定域名，最常见的错误是使用自定义协议处理器作为回调且不做校验，任何网页都能构造同样的协议链接把授权码送进来。正确做法是使用带 PKCE 的授权码模式，并对回调内容做本地校验（包括 state 与由本地生成的 code_verifier）。另外，不要为了让回调"更简单"而退回隐式模式。
sections.p_en: Local apps lack a fixed domain, and the common error is a custom protocol handler as callback with no validation, so any web page can fire the same link and deliver a code. Use authorization code flow with PKCE and validate locally, including state and the locally generated code_verifier. Never fall back to implicit flow to simplify the callback.

refs.name: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

quiz.q: 回调地址校验为什么必须精确匹配而不能前缀匹配？
options: 前缀匹配会放过相似域名，攻击者可据此接走授权码
quiz.explain: 在合法域名后追加自己的域名即可通过前缀检查，这是经典陷阱。
quiz.q_en: Why must redirect URIs be matched exactly rather than by prefix?
options_en: Prefix matching admits lookalike domains that can receive the code
quiz.explain_en: Appending your own domain after the legitimate one passes a prefix check — a classic trap.

quiz.q: state 参数主要防止什么？
options: 把攻击者的授权码注入受害者会话，造成账户串联
quiz.explain: 未校验 state 会允许登录 CSRF，把受害者绑定到攻击者身份。
quiz.q_en: What does the state parameter primarily prevent?
options_en: Injecting an attacker code into a victim session, causing account stitching
quiz.explain_en: Unvalidated state enables login CSRF, binding the victim to the attacker identity.

quiz.q: 桌面应用接入 OAuth 时最应该避免什么？
options: 使用自定义协议回调且不做任何校验
quiz.explain: 任何网页都能构造同样的自定义协议链接，把授权码送进本地应用。
quiz.q_en: What should a desktop OAuth integration most avoid?
options_en: A custom protocol callback with no validation
quiz.explain_en: Any web page can fire the same custom protocol link and deliver a code.
